celluloid-cream.$description: Celluloid Cream — Primary text, all icon strokes, 1px hairline borders, and the only outlined-link action border in the system — a warm off-white that reads as aged film stock against black

darkroom-shadow.$description: Darkroom Shadow — Atmospheric mid-surface visible around and between film stills — a desaturated warm olive-black that softens the page from pure void into projection-room dimness

projection-black.$description: Projection Black — Deep canvas void used for the darkest recesses of the page and behind embedded media; the floor beneath everything

changeling-neo.$description: Sole typeface — used for both the smallest nav label and the 280px display numerals. Weight 400 across every role is a deliberate anti-convention: no bold ever appears, so hierarchy is built purely through scale and tracking. The very tight -4% letter-spacing at 230-280px is what makes the giant wordmark feel carved rather than typeset.
